verdicts.note: Not a lone-ESSB-6346 case. The dossier also has a no vote on ESSB 5814, three amendments to 6346 (texts checked in cache), several sponsored repeal and tax-cut bills, and pamphlet and news statements. -2/high fits.

His sponsorship of HB 1365 (rental assistance for manufactured-home park tenants) [S11] leans slightly the other way. One targeted assistance bill does not offset the no votes on rent-increase limits, so -1/medium holds.

Cached campaign page confirms the plank verbatim: 'We don't need to raise taxes. We need more businesses and workers paying into the system.' That opposes new taxes but does not call for cuts and comes with no record, so -1/medium is correctly sized. The ESSB 6346 rule does not apply, since he cast no vote.

The profile facts are documented record [S1][S3]: port commissioner since 2024, first legislative race, against a 25-year incumbent. His 'I belong to the 20th. Not Olympia.' framing [S1] adds to them. Zahn and Orcutt were scored high on facts of the same kind, so +1 stays and confidence rises to high for consistency.
